facility.name: The Lighthouse School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered the driver did not demonstrate good judgement when they accelerated to miss a car. A warning was given by the police.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There is chipped paint, water stained ceiling tile, broken piece of wood that could cut a child, a broken drain on the playground that could cut a child due to the sharp edged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: A changing mat has a hole in it. Foam was exposed in which a child could choke on it. This was corrected during the inspection when the mat was replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Per video a child's shoes were tied so tightly by staff that medical attention had to be sought.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Per video a child was grabbed by staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: All 4 drivers have expired transportation training. The last training was completed in 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In Preschool II classroom there is chipped paint within reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care: Two vans were missing guide to first aide. This was corrected during the inspection when the guides were placed in the vans
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Based on the information provided bottles were being propped up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Based on interviews conducted children under the age of two are watching videos.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: A four month old was laying on a bobby pillow being fed by staff and not being held.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information gathered the provider did not report to Child Care Regulation the mistreatment of children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information gathered a teacher would make children cry and forced them sit down. The teacher is no longer at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on interviews several witnesses saw a teacher yell at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: All the playgrounds  have overgrown grass and weeds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information provided the incident report was not shared with the parent when their child chipped their tooth while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The playgrounds had overgrown weeds and grass that the children were playing in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was heard by Child Care Regulation a teacher yelled at a child to sit down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: Two 15 month old heads were covered with a blanket. Per the teacher this helps the children sleep. The teacher removed the blankets from their heads when brought to the attention by CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §746.2429)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There is a tripping hazard on the playground. There is an exposed pipe. A picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the Toddler Two Playground there is an exposed white pipe where the children run and walk around the playground. The exposed pipe poses a tripping hazard. A picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The provider did not contact Childcare Regulation when a child was grabbed leaving red marks on their arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information provided a child was grabbed leaving red marks on the child's arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In the infant classroom there were 13 infants. The specified age group was 10 months. The ratio was over by 3 infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Benefits: Operational policies do not address promotion of physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: it was found that the diaper changing mat has a tear exposing the foam.     Note: A picture was taken. This was corrected at inspection when it was replaced with a new one.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: It was found that caregivers did not do name to face/count when the children were moved from the classroom to gym for the movie.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found a child was left unsupervised in the classroom close to an hour. Child was asleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Cleaning supplies was hanging up in both school age bathrooms, in reach of children.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the cleaning supplies was moved to a higher shelf.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Feeding instructions for 3 children not yet on table food have not been updated since August of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: While reviewing 6 childrens records the following was observed:    1. One child needs an address for their school.  2. Two children need hearing and vision tests.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit in one out of three buses was missing a thermometer, scissors and tweezers.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the items were added to the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extenguisher on one bus needs to be serviced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was not up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the turtle classroom, the tank lid was missing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on the DFPS investigation video footage obtained showed a caregiver was using an electronic device while caring for children. The caregiver was looking was looking down at the device and not engaging with the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development: A caregiver placed a three-month-old child in a stationary jumper; the child cannot yet support himself in the upright position therefore this is not an age appropriate activity or age appropriate equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2417(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: During the DFPS investigation it was determined that instead of holding the 4 month old child, staff propped their bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver failed to intervene when necessary to ensure a child's safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: During the investigation, it was determined that caregivers were separating children from the group for 30 minutes as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: During the investigation, it was determined that parents were not notified of their children being a part of the allegation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.307(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the findings of a DFPS investigation it was determined that the following forms of inappropriate discipline were used, hitting, slapping, biting, pushing, grabbing and dragging a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: During the investigation, it was determined the director did not properly supervise a caregiver allowing the caregiver to remain in the classroom after concerns were identified with the caregiver's interactions with children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the findings from a DFPS investigation the operation employed a caregiver who was found to be abusive in her interactions with the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: During the investigation, it was determined that the director did not report the suspected abuse to licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))
